reproduction_target: Computational analysis of the CLAMP heat-stress 3D-chromatin study: SLAM-seq nascent-RNA differential expression (nf-core/slamseq -> DESeq2), Micro-C differential chromatin interactions (HiC-Pro -> HiCcompare), HiChIP loop calling (BWA/pairtools/cooler -> FitHiChIP/MACS2/edgeR), APA (coolpup.py), and cross-assay integration of Micro-C/HiChIP/SLAM-seq (bedtools + custom Python), plus reuse of public ChIP-seq (deeptools).
granularity_note: Coarse one-step-per-named-tool from Methods 'Computational analysis' (a) SLAM-seq, (b) Micro-C, (c) HiChIP, (d) integration, (e) ChIP-seq. Stage-2 code-check read the two claim-bearing third-party repos at line level: nf-core/slamseq @tag 1.0.0 (environment.yml, Dockerfile, nextflow.config, conf/base.config) and ay-lab/FitHiChIP (Dockerfile, Singularity, Imp_Scripts/DiffAnalysisHiChIP.r, Differential_Analysis_Script.sh). No author-owned repository and no Code Availability statement exist, so C13/C14 remain undeposited. Wet-lab library generation counted in W, not verdicted.

steps.label: nf-core/slamseq v1.0.0 pipeline (-profile singularity; internally Trim Galore 0.6.5 + SlamDunk 0.4.3; full params: --genome BDGP6 --read_length 150 --trim5 12 --polyA 4 --multimappers true --min_coverage 2 --var_fraction 0.2 --conversions 1 --base_quality 27 --pvalue 0.05) — SLAM-seq processing
DESeq2 (1.22.1) — SLAM-seq differential expression (padj <= 0.05, fold change >= 1.5)
HiC-Pro toolkit (3.1.0, default params) + cooler-format conversion utils (nservant/HiC-Pro/bin/utils) — Micro-C mapping and normalized contact maps
HiCcompare (1.24.0) in Bioconductor (3.18) — Micro-C differential chromatin interactions (P < 0.01)
Burrows-Wheeler Aligner (0.7.17) mem — HiChIP (and ChIP-seq) alignment to dm6 (args -5 -S -P -T0 for HiChIP; default for ChIP)
pairtools (0.3.0) parse/dedup/split — HiChIP valid ligation events (--min-mapq 40 --walks-policy 5unique --max-inter-align-gap 30)
cooler suite (0.9.3) — HiChIP/Micro-C contact-map generation from pair files
FitHiChIP (10.0) — HiChIP loop calling (ay-lab/FitHiChIP; resolution-adjustable interaction categories)
MACS2 (2.2.9.1) — 1D peak calling on HiChIP data (required input for FitHiChIP)

edgeR (no version given) differential-loop analysis — code-check finding: this is FitHiChIP's OWN built-in tool (ay-lab/FitHiChIP Imp_Scripts/DiffAnalysisHiChIP.r + Differential_Analysis_Script.sh), a PUBLIC third-party feature, NOT an undeposited author custom script; edgeR remains version-floating (BiocManager::install('edgeR') with no version pin in FitHiChIP's own Dockerfile)
coolpup.py suite (1.0.0) — APA plots over differential loop focal points (central bin 2.5 kb)

bedtools suite (2.31.0, pairtobed) + custom Python annotation script — Micro-C/HiChIP loop-anchor & loop-span gene annotation and SLAM-seq integration (custom script NOT deposited; confirmed undeposited at stage-2 — not in FitHiChIP, no author repo, no Code Availability statement)
matplotlib-venn (0.11.9) Python package + Fisher's Exact test with FDR correction — cross-assay gene-list overlap significance (custom analysis, NOT deposited; confirmed undeposited at stage-2)
deeptools suite (3.2.1) bamCoverage — public ChIP-seq BigWig tracks (--binSize 50 --normalizeUsing CPM --extendReads 200 --exactScaling --centerReads --blackListFileName dm6-blacklist.bed)
Trim Galore (0.5.0) — public ChIP-seq adapter/quality trimming (GSE118047, GSE30740, GSE36374, GSE36393, GSE54529, GSE63518, GSE80702, GSE89244)
coolbox API (0.3.9) — visualization of contact maps, bigwig/ChIP/nascent-RNA tracks and cross-dataset comparison over regions of interest

gaps.where: Newly generated primary data: SLAM-seq (GSE297379), HiChIP (GSE253644), and the poly(T)/nascent series (GSE253645)
gaps.missing: All three GEO Series are still PRIVATE/embargoed (reviewer-token access only) at assessment time; raw/processed files are not publicly downloadable, so the SLAM-seq, Micro-C, and HiChIP computational steps cannot be executed on the study's own data yet.
gaps.how_to_close: Release the GEO Series to public (or provide reviewer tokens) and confirm processed-file availability (contact maps, .cool/.hic, counts) plus a run-to-sample sheet.

gaps.where: Software environment capture — the C1 env_lock claim resolved at line level
gaps.missing: Stage-2 code-check: nf-core/slamseq v1.0.0 does NOT ship a static lock. nextflow.config sets process.container='nfcore/slamseq:1.0.0' (mutable tag, no @sha256 digest); Dockerfile is FROM nfcore/base:1.9 (tag); environment.yml lists only top-level version pins (trim-galore=0.6.5, slamdunk=0.4.3, bioconductor-deseq2=1.22.1, ...) with NO build strings and NO transitive closure. gaps.how_to_close: Publish the built image by digest (@sha256) or ship a conda-lock/pixi.lock with build strings for a declared platform, covering nf-core/slamseq AND the non-nf-core tools (HiC-Pro, cooler, HiCcompare/Bioconductor, BWA, pairtools, FitHiChIP+edgeR, MACS2, coolpup.py, deeptools).

gaps.where: Author analysis code / Code Availability statement
